connector.name: Nefesh - Real-Time Human State Awareness for AI
connector.registryDescription: Fuses biometric signals into a stress score (0-100) for AI adaptation. MCP + A2A native.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.nefesh.ai over streamable HTTP. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.nefesh. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.
